title: eyeprocesspy: Vendor-neutral Python infrastructure for eye-tracking and multimodal process data
description: eyeprocesspy is vendor-neutral Python infrastructure aligned to the frozen R eyeprocess 0.11.1 reference. Version 0.2.1 adds a provenance-aware static Bayesian-network layer for validated multimodal features, including explicit scientific node/data contracts, theory-constrained structure learning, posterior inference, participant-level bootstrap stability, grouped validation, detector/AOI sensitivity, plotting, reporting, and synthetic recovery tooling. The release preserves existing preprocessing, data-quality, survival-analysis, psychometric, multimodal, parity, provenance, and exact-coverage safeguards; learned directed edges are not silently interpreted as causal effects.
